caption_used: Хоризонтална стълбовидна диаграма, представяща честотата на посочване на мерки за ограничаване на скритата икономика в България. Най-високо оценената мярка е „Да се намали корупцията“ с около 18%, следвана от „Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система“ с 15%. Мерките „Да се засили данъчния контрол“ и „Да се приемат по-строги закони“ заемат средни позиции с по около 7–8%. Най-рядко посочваните мерки включват „Да се засили граничния контрол“ и „Да се намалят акцизите“, всяка с 2%.

The chart type is a horizontal bar chart. The chart has a title in Bulgarian, which translates to "What are the most important measures you think can be taken to limit the "hidden economy" in the country?"

The vertical axis contains the measures to limit the hidden economy, listed in Bulgarian. The measures are not in a specific order, such as alphabetical or categorical.

The horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents who consider each measure important, with a range from 0 to 15%. The scale is linear.

There are two colors used in the chart: red and blue. Red bars represent higher percentages, while blue bars represent lower percentages.

Notable patterns include the fact that the top three measures have significantly higher percentages than the rest, with "Да се намали корупцията" (Reduce corruption) having the highest percentage at around 13%, followed by "Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система" (Improve the efficiency of the judicial system) at around 13%, and "Да се ограничат действията на мафията" (Limit the activities of the mafia) at 10%.

Other notable measures include "Да се засили данъчният контрол" (Strengthen tax control) at 9%, "Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса" (Introduce more effective business incentives) and "Да се подобри качеството на административните услуги" is not clearly labeled but appears to be around 13%.

 Representative values include:

* Lowest values: "Да се засили граничния контрол" (Strengthen border control) and "Да се намалят акцизите" (Reduce excise duties), both at 2%.
* Mid-range values: "Да се приемат по-строги закони" (Adopt stricter laws) at 5%, "Да се намали ДДС" (Reduce VAT) at 5%.
* Highest values: "Да се намали корупцията" (Reduce corruption) at 13%, "Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система" (Improve the efficiency of the judicial system) at 13%.

The bars are not ordered in a specific way, but rather appear to be listed in a random order.

The vertical axis lists various measures in Bulgarian, while the horizontal axis displays the percentage of respondents who consider each measure important, ranging from 0 to 15%. The chart features two colors: red for higher percentages and blue for lower percentages. The top three measures have significantly higher percentages, with "Reduce corruption" and "Improve the efficiency of the judicial system" both at around 13%, and "Limit the activities of the mafia" at 10%. Other notable measures include "Strengthen tax control" at 9% and "Adopt stricter laws" at 5%. The lowest values are for "Strengthen border control" and "Reduce excise duties", both at 2%.
